ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the number of cases and the amount of money involved.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and investigation of Medicaid claims
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough analysis of Medicaid claims data could reveal a larger pattern of fraud, potentially involving multiple individuals and organizations.
